prompts.text: Please choose your language. Tap the language you want.
Hindi.
English.
Welcome to FarmTrack. It will speak to you and guide you step by step.
Type your phone number. It has ten numbers.
Now tap the green tick.
This phone number is not right. Please check it and type again.
We do not have this number. Please check it and type again.
We have sent a message to your phone.
Type the six numbers from the message.
These numbers are not right. Please look at the message and type again.
If the message does not come, wait a little and tap the round arrow.
You are in. Welcome.
Please log in again to come in.
Welcome. Please log in to come in.
Type your user name.
Now type your password.
To log in, tap the green tick.
The user name or password is not right. Please look and type again.
First type your user name and your password.
Your password is shown. Tap the eye picture again to hide it.
Your password is hidden. Tap the eye picture to see it.
This is the first page. Tap a big picture to begin.
To check a leaf, tap the big camera picture.
To see your field, tap the field picture.
To write what you sprayed, tap the notebook picture.
To ask a question, tap the question mark picture.
To change the voice or language, tap the gear picture.
Let us take a photo of a leaf. Tap the big camera picture.
Choose one leaf that has spots or damage.
Or tap the small picture of photos to choose a photo that is already in your phone.
Hold the phone close to the leaf. Keep the whole leaf in the picture.
Hold the phone still.
Take the photo in daylight.
Now tap the big round button to take the photo.
Photo taken. Well done.
You have taken one photo.
You have taken two photos.
You have taken three photos.
You have taken four photos.
That is enough. Please send these photos now.
Is the problem on other leaves too? If yes, take one more photo.
To take one more photo, tap the plus sign.
If these photos are enough, tap the green tick.
To send your photos, tap the green tick.
To remove this photo, tap the red cross.
Please take a photo first.
Sending your photos. Please wait.
We are looking at your leaf. Please wait, this takes a little time.
The photo is not clear. Hold the phone still and take it again.
The light was not right. Take the photo again where it is not too dark or too bright.
The leaf looks too small. Come closer and take the photo again.
We could not see a leaf. Bring one leaf in front of the camera and try again.
To try again, tap the big camera picture.
This looks like apple.
This looks like tomato.
This looks like potato.
This looks like maize.
This looks like grapes.
This looks like pear.
This looks like plum.
This looks like peach.
This looks like apricot.
This looks like cherry.
This looks like walnut.
This looks like pomegranate.
This looks like kiwi.
This looks like strawberry.
This looks like peas.
This looks like cauliflower.
This looks like cabbage.
This looks like capsicum.
This looks like beans.
This looks like wheat.
This looks like paddy.
This looks like barley.
This looks like ginger.
This looks like cucumber.
This looks like mango.
This looks like citrus.
This looks like litchi.
I could not tell the crop.
Is this the right crop?
If it is right, tap the green tick.
If it is wrong, tap the red cross.
Tap the picture of your crop.
Here is what we found. Please listen carefully.
I am not sure about this one. Please do not spray any medicine yet.
Done. Your photos are saved.
We do not have advice for this crop yet. Please ask a farm expert.
We could not see a disease in this photo. If you are still worried, take another photo.
To listen again, tap the speaker picture.
After you spray, write it in your diary. Tap the notebook picture.
This is your spray diary. Write here what you sprayed on your field.
Tap the medicine you sprayed.
Tap the day you sprayed.
If you have sprayed, tap the green tick.
To write it in the diary, tap the green tick.
Done. It is saved in your diary.
Please listen carefully. There is a warning about this medicine.
This is your field page. You can see your weather and sprays here.
This information is old. Turn on the internet to see new information.
Your field information is up to date.
There is no information for your field yet.
To hear the weather, tap the cloud picture.
You have a new alert for your field.
To hear it, tap the bell picture.
To hear more, tap the green arrow.
You have no new alerts.
Here you can ask a question about your crop.
Type your question.
To send your question, tap the green tick.
Looking for the answer. Please wait.
We could not find an answer to this question. Please ask a farm expert.
Do not worry, there is no internet right now. Please check your phone's internet.
Something went wrong, but it is not your mistake. Please try again.
No internet. Your photo is saved and will be sent later.
The internet is back. Your saved photo has been sent.
FarmTrack is being updated. Please wait a little.
Please wait a little.
Tap a picture to make the voice speak slower or faster.
Tap a picture to make the voice louder or softer.
The language has been changed.
FarmTrack needs your camera to take leaf photos. When the phone asks, tap the button that allows it.
FarmTrack wants to send you alerts about your field. When the phone asks, tap the button that allows it.
The camera is not allowed, so we cannot take photos. Please open your phone settings and allow the camera.
Alerts will not come. You can turn them on later in your phone settings.
To go to the first page, tap the house picture.
To go back, tap the arrow that points left.
Did you spray this medicine?
If you did not, tap the red cross.
Nothing is written yet. To write a spray, tap the plus picture.
To write a spray you did, tap the plus picture.
Tap the picture of the crop you sprayed.
Type the name of the medicine you sprayed.
Or tap a name you used before.
Today.
Yesterday.
Another day.
No internet. Your spray note is saved and will be sent later.
The internet is back. Your spray note has been sent.
This note is waiting for the internet.
To see new information, tap the round arrow.
To see the result of your photo, tap the green arrow.
Your saved photos and diary entries are waiting for the internet. They will be sent when it comes.
The result is ready. Tap the green card on the first page.
Do you want to log out? Tap the green tick for yes, or the red cross for no.
Tap a picture to ask that question. To ask your own question, tap the keyboard picture.
Done. Your question is saved.
What should I do if it rains after I spray?
How many days should I wait between my last spray and the harvest?
Can I mix other chemicals with my spray?
How do I protect myself when I spray?
When does apple scab spread?
What should I do with the fallen leaves in my orchard?
How many days should I keep between two sprays?
Can I use the same chemical again and again?
Should I spray even when there is no risk of disease?
How can I prevent diseases in my orchard?
